links.quote: The Mosamatic tool displays excellent generalizability to analyse body compositions in Chinese gastric cancer patients and can facilitate cachexia research.

links.outcome: Performance of European-trained model in Chinese external population
links.effect: Excellent generalizability without recalibration; low BMI (<18.5) and ascites impaired agreement between methods
links.quote: The Mosamatic tool displayed excellent generalizability without recalibration to analyse body composition on the 3rd lumbar vertebral CT images in Chinese gastric cancer patients.

screen.reason: This study is an external validation of an existing deep learning segmentation tool (Mosamatic) on a retrospective Chinese cancer cohort without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
